However, GCSP has consulted on a new single Local Validation Checklist covering Cambridge City and South Cambridgeshire, with consultation closed 28 July 2026 and comments under review. The workbook should flag that a joint list is pending and the current SCDC pages may soon be replaced.

issues.detail: Several requirements on the SCDC Full planning checklist were not captured. Transport assessment or statement: residential at or above 20 dwellings or 0.5 ha, other uses 1,000 sq m or 1 ha. Travel plan: same thresholds. Traffic management plan: all non-householder development. Marketing assessment/local needs: loss of facilities such as pubs, shops or businesses. Broadband information: new residential, employment and commercial development. Community facilities: 200 or more homes. Surface water drainage strategy: all scales of development. Energy statement: all major new development. Parking provision is captured only under prior approval.
issues.evidence: Full planning page: 'Transport assessment or statement - Residential Developments at or above 20 dwellings or 0.5 hectares'; 'Traffic management plan - Required for all non-householder development'; 'Community facilities - For new developments of 200 homes or more'

issues.detail: Several rows use text from a different requirement as their trigger. 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' uses foul drainage text; the real Surface water drainage strategy is required 'for all scales of development'. 'Waste / Refuse' uses the Biodiversity Net Gain text; the real Waste design guide toolkit trigger is all commercial development and new residential units. 'Daylight / Sunlight' uses the Design masterplan text; the real trigger is buildings that would overshadow neighbouring buildings or open spaces. 'Energy / Sustainability' uses the Sustainability checklist trigger ('all sizes of development') and misses the separate Energy statement for major development. 'Noise Impact Assessment' is just a list of WHO/IEMA references. 'Self-build / custom build' and 'Housing mix / dwelling standards' both use Housing statement text (mix for 10 or more homes; space standards for all residential).
issues.evidence: Grokbot Waste trigger: '...RECAP Waste Management Design Guide ... Biodiversity Net Gain assessment When it is required You must demonstrate how your major development site meets...'

issues.detail: The Affordable Housing Statement trigger ('will be required to show compliance with policy') leaves out the threshold. The source says all major developments of 10 or more dwellings or 0.5 ha, plus rural exception sites.
issues.evidence: 'Housing statement - affordable housing - For all major developments of 10 dwellings or more'

issues.detail: 'Schedule of works (listed building)' is listed under both Householder and Full planning, but its trigger is Arboricultural Method Statement text from the Tree survey item. Neither checklist contains a listed building schedule of works.
issues.evidence: Grokbot trigger: 'Applicants will need to submit an Arboriculture Method Statement in accordance with BS 5837...'

issues.detail: Outline, Reserved matters, Listed building consent, Advertisement, both LDCs, s73, Discharge of conditions, NMA and Prior approvals are all shown as '(none)'. SCDC publishes a separate checklist page for each, and Grokbot did not read them. The Outline checklist has about 35 local requirements, the same as Full (air quality, foul sewage/utilities, housing statements, parking, surface water drainage, transport/travel plan, broadband, community facilities, energy, waste, etc.). The LBC checklist requires a Heritage statement (local) and Detailed drawings for all LBC applications.
issues.evidence: Outline checklist (reviewed 09 June 2026): 'Foul sewage and utilities - All new development (Local)'; LBC checklist: 'Detailed drawings - proposed - Required for all listed building consent applications'

issues.detail: FRA and Parking provision are placed under 'Change of use - prior approval' only because their text mentions 'change of use'. They come from the Full planning checklist, and SCDC has a separate Prior Approvals checklist that Grokbot did not read. About 25 other Full planning rows carry the unnecessary 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' note even though the source page is the Full planning checklist.
issues.evidence: Hub lists a separate South Cambridgeshire 'Prior Approvals' checklist page

issues.detail: 'Character / Conservation area appraisal reference' (Householder and Full planning) is not a requirement. It is a fragment of the Heritage statement reference list ('Conservation Area appraisals, Cambridgeshire Historic Environment Record') joined to the next item's text (Noise/vibration or Planning statement).
issues.evidence: Grokbot trigger: 'building descriptions Conservation Area appraisals Cambridgeshire Historic Environment Record Planning statement Is it required?...'

issues.detail: The Noise/vibration assessment is split into two rows ('Noise Impact Assessment' and 'Odour / Dust / Vibration assessment') under both Householder and Full planning. The Sequential/Exception Test is listed separately, although it is guidance inside the Flood risk assessment item, not a separate validation item. 'Design Code / Masterplan' and 'Daylight / Sunlight' share the same text.
issues.evidence: Source has a single heading 'Noise/vibration assessment'

summary: Grokbot's link is the live, current SCDC Full planning checklist (reviewed 28 Jan 2026), but a joint GCSP list is pending after a July 2026 consultation. Transport/travel plan, traffic management, surface water drainage, broadband and community facilities are missing. Several triggers are taken from the wrong section, and all other application-type checklists were skipped, leaving them as '(none)'.
